parsed.why: Sodomy statute unenforced for over a decade; no prosecutions, no trans-specific targeting documented. But criminalising regime, no protections, hostile elite rhetoric, and no relief record — thin data extrapolates toward structural risk, not neutrality.

Formal decriminalisation offset by documented 2023-24 state crackdown, morality-law harassment of LGBT people, coerced closure of queer spaces, smear campaigns inciting violence, cybercrime law, and 93% societal rejection — state-tolerated targeting tier.

Trans depiction classed as pornography, propaganda ban on gender reassignment, immediate mass detentions including eight trans people in one month, custody abuse, police data-collection on LGBT people, state propaganda equating trans identity with paedophilia — state-directed targeting.

LGBT movement designated extremist with 101 convictions, rainbow-symbol arrests, 18-fold propaganda-case growth, mass venue raids with photography, death in custody of an LGBT detainee, transition banned — the most systematic state campaign of the five.

Decriminalisation struck down and statute deleted, constitutional LGR rulings granted to trans people, registered national LGBT organisation, official presidential protection signals, no documented trans violence; some societal friction and slow implementation keep it below top tier.
